name: Nortista/Amazônico Portuguese
notes: Nortista (Belém, Pará). Coda /S/ is palatal [ʃ ʒ]: ALiB gives above 76 % palatal only in Rio de Janeiro, Belém and Florianópolis (Borges & Mendonça 2019: 58, quoting Cardoso et al. 2014: 111). /t d/ affricate before [i]: Belém 88 % (Oliveira 2013: 216) and categorical in ALiB (Battisti & Dornelles Filho 2015: 226). Pretonic /e o/ stay closed as in the base: 'a região Norte não pode ser caracterizada como uma área de vogais abertas' (Mota & Lopes 2018: 217). Coda /R/ is the glottal [h], dominant in the North in the ALiB maps (Silva & Aguilera, preprint, not peer reviewed). Manaus is outside this spec: its word-final /S/ is 67.1 % alveolar (Marins & Margotti 2012: 265).

allophone_rules.notes: The palatal coda sibilant of this variety is [ʃ], so the base rule must also match [ʃ]; the plural endings raise as in the base (dentes, ovos).
The palatal coda sibilant of this variety is [ʃ], so the base rule must also match [ʃ]; the plural endings raise as in the base (dentes, ovos).

The palatal coda /S/ takes the voicing of a following voiced consonant: mesmo [ˈmeʒmu], desde [ˈdeʒd͡ʒi]. Marins & Margotti (2012: 255) report six coda /S/ realisations in the Pará atlas data, among them 'pós-alveolar (surda e sonora)', and for Belém that 'é a variante pós-alveolar que é utilizada com mais frequência'. The positional map writes the coda as [ʃ]; this rule voices it in the second pass.
